title: The Environmental Cost of Perfect Lawns

paragraphs.english: In the quest for the perfect lawn, homeowners across the country are taking a shortcut — and it is the environment that is paying the price. About eight million square metres of plastic grass is sold each year but opposition has now spread to the highest gardening circles. The Chelsea Flower Show has banned fake grass from this year’s event, declaring it to be not part of its ethos. The Royal Horticultural Society (RHS), which runs the annual show in west London, says it has introduced the ban because of the damage plastic grass does to the environment and biodiversity.
paragraphs.chinese: 为了拥有完美的草坪，全国各地的房主正在走一条捷径，而为此付出代价的却是环境。每年售出的塑料草坪面积约有800万平方米，但如今反对声音已经传到了园艺界的最高层。切尔西花展已禁止在今年的展会上使用人造草坪，称它不符合花展的理念。每年在伦敦西部举办这一展会的英国皇家园艺学会表示，推出禁令是因为塑料草坪会损害环境和生物多样性。

paragraphs.english: Ed Horne, of the RHS, said: “We launched our sustainability strategy last year and fake grass is just not in line with our ethos and views on plastic. We recommend using real grass because of its environmental benefits, which include supporting wildlife, alleviating flooding and cooling the environment.”
paragraphs.chinese: 皇家园艺学会的埃德·霍恩说：“我们去年推出了可持续发展战略，人造草坪确实不符合我们的理念和对塑料的看法。我们建议使用天然草坪，因为它具有环境效益，包括支持野生动物生存、缓解洪涝和降低环境温度。”

paragraphs.english: The RHS’s decision comes as campaigners try to raise awareness of the problems fake grass causes. A Twitter account, which claims to “cut through the greenwash” of artificial grass, already has more than 20,000 followers. It is trying to encourage people to sign two petitions, one calling for a ban on the sale of plastic grass and another calling for an “ecological damage” tax on such lawns. They have gathered 7,276 and 11,282 signatures.
paragraphs.chinese: 就在皇家园艺学会作出这一决定之际，倡议人士正在努力提升公众对人造草坪所带来问题的认识。一个声称要“揭穿”人造草坪“漂绿宣传”的推特账号，已经拥有超过两万名关注者。该账号正鼓励人们签署两份请愿书，一份要求禁止销售塑料草坪，另一份要求对这类草坪征收“生态损害税”。两份请愿分别征集到7276个和11282个签名。

paragraphs.english: However, supporters of fake grass point out that there is also an environmental impact with natural lawns, which need mowing and therefore usually consume electricity or petrol. The industry also points out that real grass requires considerable amounts of water, weed killer or other treatments and that people who lay fake grass tend to use their garden more. The industry also claims that people who lay fake grass spend an average of £500 on trees or shrubs for their garden, which provides habitat for insects.
paragraphs.chinese: 不过，人造草坪的支持者指出，天然草坪同样会影响环境，因为它需要修剪，通常因此要消耗电力或汽油。行业人士还指出，天然草坪需要大量水、除草剂或其他养护措施，而且铺设人造草坪的人往往更频繁地使用自家庭院。行业也宣称，这些人平均会花500英镑为庭院购买树木或灌木，为昆虫提供栖息地。

paragraphs.english: In response to another petition last year about banning fake lawns, which gathered 30,000 signatures, the government responded that it has “no plans to ban the use of artificial grass.”
paragraphs.chinese: 去年，另一份要求禁止人造草坪的请愿书征集到了三万个签名。政府对此回应说，它“没有禁止使用人造草坪的计划”。

paragraphs.english: It added: “We prefer to help people and organizations make the right choice rather than legislating on such matters. However, the use of artificial grass must comply with the legal and policy safeguards in place to protect biodiversity and ensure sustainable drainage, while measures such as the strengthened biodiversity duty should serve to encourage public authorities to consider sustainable alternatives.”
paragraphs.chinese: 政府补充说：“比起就这类问题立法，我们更愿意帮助个人和组织作出正确选择。不过，人造草坪的使用必须遵守现有的法律和政策保障措施，以保护生物多样性并确保可持续排水；与此同时，强化生物多样性保护责任等措施，应当促使公共机构考虑可持续的替代方案。”

sentenceNotes.sentence: The Royal Horticultural Society (RHS), which runs the annual show in west London, says it has introduced the ban because of the damage plastic grass does to the environment and biodiversity.
sentenceNotes.mainClause: The Royal Horticultural Society ... says it has introduced the ban.
sentenceNotes.structure: which从句补充说明学会是花展举办者；says后省略that；damage后省略关系代词，plastic grass does ...修饰damage；because of引出原因。
sentenceNotes.translation: 每年在伦敦西部举办这一展会的英国皇家园艺学会表示，推出禁令是因为塑料草坪会损害环境和生物多样性。
sentenceNotes.tip: the damage ... does to ...是固定搭配do damage to的嵌入形式，does并不是又一个独立主句谓语。
